Tapo Care cloud or local microSD storage
release_notes: Outdoor dual-lens pan/tilt camera — the outdoor counterpart of the indoor C245D and indoor/outdoor C246D. Dual 2K 3MP resolution, both lens FOV figures, the wide-angle manual pan/tilt ranges, motorized telephoto control, colour night vision, and 512 GB microSD from the official TP-Link C545D datasheet. Sensor, focal lengths, apertures, IR range, IP rating, power method, dimensions, and weight omitted: not present in the recovered datasheet text.

frigate.notes: Mains-powered Tapo cameras expose RTSP once a Camera Account is created in the Tapo app (Settings > Advanced > Camera Account). Dual-lens streams (community-confirmed): wide-angle lens = /stream1 (main) + /stream2 (sub); telephoto pan/tilt lens = /stream6 (main) + /stream7 (sub). Add each lens as its own Frigate camera. go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP (fewer timeouts / non-monotonic-timestamp errors). The password form is firmware-dependent: either your Tapo app/cloud account password, or user `admin` + the UPPERCASE SHA-256 of the camera password (`tapo://admin:<UPPERCASE-SHA256>@{ip}`) — see go2rtc's Tapo docs. It is not the camera's plain RTSP/Device password. If non-monotonic-timestamp errors persist, disable audio for that camera in Frigate. Chrome may render the go2rtc live view with a squashed aspect ratio (a browser live-view quirk, not the stream); Firefox is correct. The go2rtc tapo:// source also carries a two-way-audio backchannel, so Frigate's live view gets a talk button (mic+speaker). Pan/tilt: Tapo exposes ONVIF PTZ on port 2020 (not 80) — point Frigate's onvif block at host:<ip> port:2020 with the camera Account credentials for manual pan/tilt. (Frigate autotracking stays off: Tapo only does continuous-move ONVIF, no reliable absolute/FOV positioning.)

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: wide lens /stream1 (+/stream2 sub), telephoto lens /stream6 (+/stream7 sub). Must enable ONVIF/Camera Account in the Tapo app.
